name: 172.3 — loading and saving a combat school
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 172.3: school:load() and school:save() send what the tab's Load and Save buttons send (load or save, then use, with the school's wire), take no argument, refuse an unused school's load naming school:empty(), and :current(x) names school:load(). Every send is cancelled before it reaches the server.
